entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: A deep jungle forest on the continent of Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria containing the Scarwood.

entities.name: Dark Heart of the Wood
entities.description: A site hidden at the center of the Scarwood.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Creator of the first cat warriors by fusing man and tiger; later disappeared.

entities.name: Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: A place of worship to Terrent Amese built by tiger warriors.

entities.name: Scarwood elves
entities.description: Elves who claimed the forest after the cat warriors left.

entities.name: Sulaki
entities.description: Tiger warrior descendants who fought the elves.

entities.name: Hooraree
entities.description: Pilgrims descended from the tiger warrior tribe.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: The first cat warrior to visit the Dark Heart since the exodus.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: Guardian of the Dark Heart, killed by Jedit.

events.summary: Terrent Amese creates the first cat warriors to protect the Dark Heart, who build the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale.
events.quote: Terrent Amese created the first cat warriors by fusing the essence of man and tiger

events.summary: After the exodus of the cat warriors, the Scarwood elves claim the forest and fend off tiger-warrior descendants.
events.quote: the Scarwood elves would claim the forest as their own

events.summary: A tribe of sapient apes displaces the elves.
events.quote: the elves in turn were displaced by a tribe of sapient apes

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Dark Heart in 3336 AR, defeats the apes, and kills its guardian Ur-Drago.
Jedit convinces the four cat warrior tribes that Terrent Amese was not a god and negotiates safe passage through the Scarwood.
events.quote: Jedit was able to negotiate safe passage through the Scarwood for any cat warrior

relations.note: He had the tiger warriors build it.
relations.quote: He then had the tiger warriors build the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
Scarwood is a forest on the continent of Jamuraa
